title: Stop Training Against Soft Users: Mentalized Adversarial Self-Play for Proactive Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2610.21156v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proactive dialogue agents must guide multi-turn interactions toward task goals while adapting to users whose intentions and attitudes evolve. Existing planners improve system side action selection through search, learned policies, or user aware planning, but are often trained and evaluated against fixed or overly compliant simulators; as a result, high simulated success can reflect soft user bias rather than robust dialogue ability. We introduce MASP, a Mentalized Adversarial Self Play framework that treats proactive dialogue as a partially observable game between a system and a rationally resisting user. MASP represents the user's evolving mental state with a BDI based latent state, separates reward side teacher mentalization from policy side student mentalization, and alternates self play updates for the system and user policies. translated_title: 停止针对“软用户”训练：面向主动对话的心理化对抗自我博弈
translated_abstract: 主动对话智能体必须在多轮交互中引导对话朝着任务目标推进，同时适应用户不断演变的意图和态度。现有的规划器通过搜索、学习策略或用户感知规划来改进系统侧的动作选择，但它们通常是在固定或过于顺从的模拟器上进行训练和评估的；因此，较高的模拟成功率可能反映的是“软用户”偏差，而非真正稳健的对话能力。我们提出了MASP——一个心理化对抗自我博弈框架，它将主动对话视为系统与理性抵抗的用户之间的部分可观测博弈。MASP使用基于BDI的潜在状态来表示用户不断变化的心理状态，将奖励侧的“教师心理化”与策略侧的“学生心理化”分离，并交替对系统策略和用户策略进行自我博弈更新。这使得对抗理性抵抗的鲁棒性成为训练目标，而不仅仅是评估条件。
tldr: 该论文提出MASP框架，将主动对话建模为系统与理性抵抗用户之间的部分可观测博弈，通过BDI潜在状态刻画用户心理并交替进行系统与用户策略的自我博弈训练，从而把对抗理性抵抗的鲁棒性变成训练目标而非仅是评估条件。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MASP, a mentalized adversarial self-play framework that models proactive dialogue as a partially observable game between the system and a rationally resisting user, using BDI-based latent states and alternating self-play updates to make robustness to rational resistance a training objective rather than merely an evaluation condition.
